title: Flak Cannon
description: [gold]Exhaust[/gold] ALL your Status cards. Deal 8 damage to a random enemy for each card [gold]Exhausted[/gold].
upgraded_description: [gold]Exhaust[/gold] ALL your Status cards. Deal 11 damage to a random enemy for each card [gold]Exhausted[/gold].
notes: The card exhausts all Status cards in your hand (excluding those already in the Exhaust pile) and deals damage to a random enemy equal to the base damage multiplied by the number of cards exhausted.
